title: Le Morte Darthur Sir Thomas Malory's Book of King Arthur and his Noble Knights of the Round Table

Malory reworked French and English sources while imprisoned, weaving together legendary episodes like the quest for the Holy Grail and the story of Tristan and Iseult.
